claims.text: Remaining useful life is about 96 cycles (10th-90th percentile 73-108) by the ML model; the health-index trend gives 40.
The two RUL methods differ by 55 cycles (limit 20); treat the estimate as uncertain.
Most likely fault mode: HPC degradation (probability 1.00).
Sensors pulling the RUL estimate down most: T24 (lpc), Ps30 (hpc), W31 (hpt).

3 similar past removals in case memory (FD001-H011 at cycle 240, FD003-H012 at cycle 170, FD003-H026 at cycle 243); the shop found HPC stage 1-3 blades eroded, tip clearance beyond limits on all 3, after removal for performance deterioration, EGT margin exhausted.
SB-TF-72-0142 3.B (service bulletin) takes precedence over AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00 (manual) on the same topic; SB recommended; adopting it needs engineering approval.
Recommended, needs engineering approval: SB-TF-72-0142 3.B (service bulletin, compliance recommended, no fleet decision yet).

Reference: AD-2026-17-04 (g) (airworthiness directive, conditions not met: RUL lower bound 33 ≥ 30 cycles); AMM-TF-R3 05-20-00 (manual); AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00 (manual, the plan follows it until engineering decides on SB-TF-72-0142 3.B, which would replace it on this topic).
Inspection finding EV-INS-01 (borescope, HPC stage 3, cycle 152): blade tip erosion 0.82 mm is above the reject limit 0.75 mm of AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00-601: beyond limits.
Inspection finding EV-INS-01 on the HPC is beyond limits, physical wear on the module HPC degradation wears: it corroborates the primary fault mode.

recommendation.action: Remove the engine before further flight (borescope, HPC stage 3 beyond limits); swap in lease engine; module shop visit on the removed engine

rationale.text: Deadline 2026-10-22 (the reference date): inspection finding EV-INS-01 is beyond limits and AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00-601 requires removal before further flight, before the remaining-life deadline 2026-11-07; the engine does not fly again until it is removed.
Trigger severity severe: planning lower bound 33 cycles (min(A 10th percentile 73, B lower 33); severe < 25, moderate < 80). Raised to severe by inspection finding EV-INS-01 (beyond limits).
Inspection finding EV-INS-01 is beyond limits per AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00-601: the plan removes the engine before further flight; nothing less meets the manual.

Selected tasks need TF-HPC-1101 (need 1, 2 on hand, 35 d lead), TF-HPC-1104 (need 1, 3 on hand, 21 d lead), TF-GEN-8102 (need 1, 30 on hand, 5 d lead), TF-ENG-9001 (need 1, 1 on hand, 21 d lead). In-stock substitutes do not replace a short required part.

Inspection finding EV-INS-01 grounds the engine now and a repair on wing waits: all parts are on hand but the next free slot is 1 d away; swap a lease engine and do the shop visit on the removed engine.
World Model task FM-HPC-06: Swap in lease engine; module shop visit on the removed engine.
World Model task FM-HPC-04: Remove engine; replace HPC stage 1-3 blades and case abradable seals.

Work package (asset-pack templates, synthetic task references): engine change at the first free slot 2026-10-23 (9 tasks, 3 RII, 30 manhours); module shop visit induction on the removed engine, in the shop (4 tasks, 0 RII, 24 manhours); before installing the lease engine, verify 5 items Cleris has no data on; 54 manhours in all.
World Model lists tasks for this fault (FM-HPC-01, FM-HPC-02, FM-HPC-03, FM-HPC-04, FM-HPC-05, FM-HPC-06); the plan uses FM-HPC-06, FM-HPC-04.

World Model links these document sections to tasks for this fault: AD-2026-17-04 (g)→FM-HPC-01, AMM-TF-R2 72-31-00→FM-HPC-01, AMM-TF-R3 71-00-00→FM-HPC-06, AMM-TF-R3 72-31-00→FM-HPC-01, AMM-TF-R3 72-31-10→FM-HPC-02, SB-TF-72-0142 3.B→FM-HPC-01; which apply now and which are mandatory is decided by the knowledge agent.
Similar past removals in case memory gave a median of 27 cycles of warning (127 cases).

agents.name: data

agents.name: prognostics

agents.name: diagnostics
agents.role: Fault-mode match and similar past cases; checks both candidates when unclear; checks an inspection finding against the fault mode

agents.name: knowledge
agents.role: Applicable documents in precedence order, mandates decided in code; the limit section for each inspection finding, compared in code; binds a missing mandate

agents.name: maint_planner
agents.role: Task, parts, slot and deadline from the RUL lower bound; applies the routed fixes

agents.name: rule_checks
agents.role: Deterministic gate: citations, numbers, parts, slots, deadlines, mandates
